character.name: Tera
desc: A debt collector. His cards use <c=status>TAX</c> to damage enemies and <c=status>BAILOUT</c> to negate <c=keyword>negative statuses</c>.

tax.name: Tax
tax.desc: On end of turn, deal <c=keyword>1</c> damage for every <c=keyword>3</c> <c=status>TAX</c>.

persistence.name: Interest
persistence.desc: Increase <c=status>TAX</c> by {0} at the start of turn.

StallNext.name: Engine Stall Next Turn
StallNext.desc: <c=downside>Gain <c=keyword>1</c> <c=status>ENGINE STALL</c> at the start of turn</c>  and decrease this status by <c=keyword>1</c>.

LockNext.name: Engine Lock Next Turn
LockNext.desc: <c=downside>Gain <c=keyword>1</c> <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c> at the start of turn</c> and decrease this status by <c=keyword>1</c>.

Bailout.name: Bailout
Bailout.desc: The next time you would gain any amount of a <c=downside>negative status</c>, instead remove <c=keyword>1</c> <c=status>BAILOUT</c>.

Dividends.name: Dividends
Dividends.desc: At the start of your turn, if you do not have <c=status>BAILOUT</c>, gain {0} <c=status>BAILOUT</c>.

TaxEvasion.name: Tax Evasion
TaxEvasion.desc: <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c> and 2 <c=status>temp shield</c>.
TaxEvasion.descA: <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c> and 3 <c=status>temp shield</c>.
TaxEvasion.descB: Gain 2 <c=status>temp shield</c>. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c>.

TaxExemption.name: Tax Exemption
TaxExemption.desc: Gain <c=status>shield</c> equal to enemy <c=status>tax</c>, then <c=downside>remove 1 tax</c>.
TaxExemption.descB: Gain <c=status>temp shield</c> equal to enemy <c=status>tax</c>, then <c=downside>remove 1 tax</c>.

Overdraft.name: Overdraft
Overdraft.desc: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage1}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to shoot again for <c=attack>{{damage2}}</c> dmg.
Overdraft.descA: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage1}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to shoot again for <c=attack>{{damage2}}</c> dmg.
Overdraft.descB: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage1}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 2 enemy tax</c> to shoot for <c=attack>{{damage1}}</c> dmg <c=keyword>four</c> more times.

TeraCatEXE.name: Tera.EXE
TeraCatEXE.desc: Enemy +2 <c=status>tax</c>. Add 1 of 3 <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=266fd8>Tera</c> cards to your hand.
TeraCatEXE.descA: Enemy +2 <c=status>tax</c>. Add 1 of 3 <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=266fd8>Tera</c> cards to your hand.
TeraCatEXE.descB: +2 <c=status>bailout</c>. Add 1 of 5 <c=cardtrait>discount, temp</c> <c=266fd8>Tera</c> cards to your hand.

Normal.name: Tax Drone
Normal.description: A drone stuffed with wads of cash. Shoots a <c=damage>0</c> damage shot that applies 1 <c=status>TAX</c>.

EarlyBird.name: EARLY BIRD
EarlyBird.desc: At the start of combat, add 1 <c=card>Gets The Worm</c> to your hand.

FlightTraining.name: FLIGHT TRAINING
FlightTraining.desc:
Gain 1 <c=status>EVADE</c> every 3 times the enemy gains <c=status>TAX</c>. 
<c=downside>Caps at 2 per turn.</c>

YearlyPayments.name: YEARLY PAYMENTS
YearlyPayments.desc: At the start of combat, add 2 <c=status>TAX</c> to the enemy.

GovernmentGrant.name: GOVERNMENT GRANT
GovernmentGrant.desc: At the start of combat, gain 1 <c=status>BAILOUT</c>. Apply 1 <c=status>TAX</c> to the enemy every time you lose <c=status>BAILOUT</c>.

Capitalism.name: CAPITALISM
Capitalism.desc: At the start of combat, gain <c=energy>1 energy</c>. <c=downside>Gain one tax a turn (caps at 3)</c>.

Inflation.name: INFLATION
Inflation.desc: <c=status>TAX</c> now does damage on increments of <c=keyword>2</c> instead of <c=keyword>3</c>.

Drake.name: FIRE SALE
Drake.desc: Gain 1 <c=status>BAILOUT</c> whenever you end your turn with 2+ <c=status>HEAT</c>.

Riggs.name: YEARLY CYCLE
Riggs.desc: Every <c=keyword>12th</c> time you draw a card, apply 1 <c=status>TAX</c> to the enemy.

Isaac.name: IMPROVISATION
Isaac.desc: At the start of combat, add 1 <c=card>Tax Drone</c> to your hand.

Peri.name: COLLECTOR'S BEST FRIEND
Peri.desc: If you were to lose <c=status>OVERDRIVE</c> while having <c=status>BAILOUT</c>, instead lose 1 <c=status>BAILOUT</c>.

Books.name: Money Laundering
Books.desc: Every 2 times you gain <c=status>SHARD</c> over your maximum shard capacity, apply 1 <c=status>TAX</c> to the enemy.
